summary: Mint Incorporation Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting a registered direct offering of 1,400,000 Class A ordinary shares at $1.00 per share and pre-funded warrants for 1,100,000 shares at $0.999 per warrant, raising approximately $2.5 million in gross proceeds. The offering closed on August 28, 2026, with Maxim Group LLC as placement agent. Proceeds will be used for working capital. This is a routine capital raise under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation, and no extraordinary corporate action is involved.
